description: Use when you need games whose published call, roof, window, or kick-window reading moved since a time you give. Pass since (ISO time). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A reading counts at 10 or more rain-chance points, 3 mph sustained wind, 3°F on the low, or any wetField level. Roof changes count when the call holds. Going to final is not a call change. If no snapshot is at or before since, the week's first snapshot is the baseline. Returns those moves. flips lists each published call that left one call and landed on another, with gameId, from, to, and at. since is thursday when the current call differs from the Thursday board, and prior when it differs from the compared snapshot. When that snapshot is the Thursday board, since is thursday. Calls and readings are copied from published boards.

since.description: ISO-8601 time. Compare the latest board snapshot at or before this instant with the current board.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
